import importlib.util, sys, io, os

def load(name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, f"{name}.py")
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(m)
    return m

# m01 off_by_one
m=load("m01"); print("m01 total([1,2,3])=", m.total([1,2,3]), "(drops last -> off_by_one)")

# m02 mutable_default

# m03 shadowed_builtin
m=load("m03"); print("m03 mean([1,2,3])=", m.mean([1,2,3]), "(local sum shadows builtin)")
print("   module has builtin sum shadowed:", hasattr(m,'sum'))

# m04 wrong_except
m=load("m04"); print("m04 parse('abc')=", m.parse("abc"), "parse(None)=", m.parse(None), "(bare except)")

# m05 integer_division
m=load("m05"); print("m05 ratio(7,2)=", m.ratio(7,2), "(// -> integer_division)")

# m06 unclosed_resource
import warnings
m=load("m06")
try:
    print("m06 read open handle never closed; source:", open("m06.py").read().replace(chr(10),' | '))
except Exception as e:
    print(e)

# m08 mutable_shared_state
